tiers.effect: Heals & HP-regen a member RECEIVES are +(0.30 + 0.008*L) (the engine heal-hook reads the layers live).

The overflow of a heal landing on a member becomes the member's own barrier (capped at the member's max HP, never decays); every enemy-sourced hit that chews that barrier deals (1000 + 10*L) TRUE damage to enemies within 1.5 tiles (周围8格, <= once per 1 s per member).

formulas.healTakenMultiplier: +(0.30 + 0.008*L) on every heal / HP-regen a member receives
formulas.barrierFromOverheal: 100% of the overflow (capped at the member's max HP, never decays)
formulas.barrierDetonation: (1000 + 10*L) TRUE damage on every enemy-sourced barrier chip, 周围8格 (radius 1.5), 1 s internal CD per member

spec.caps: barrier value capped at the member's max HP (engine overheal rule) and it NEVER decays — a 屏障 shaped like 砾's `gravel:rats` with the per-second decay removed; no lethal-hit save (user decision 2026-10-05)
spec.layerGain: None from this bond (2026-10-06): the healing-driven accumulator (1 layer per 200 HP a member healed, <= 40/battle) was removed. 罗德岛 layers come from the prep side and from the layer 特质 of its operators — 阿米娅·医疗 (heals), 阿斯卡纶 (knock-outs), 凯尔希·思衡托 / Mon3tr (skill casts), 暴行 (on acquisition).
spec.howToPlay: Field 3 distinct 罗德岛 operators to switch the bond on: the medic-heavy roster keeps them topped up and every point of healing past full is worth +30 %+0.8 %·L more. At 6 distinct, heals that overflow past a member's missing HP, Mon3tr the 链愈师's full-HP chain jumps, and 生命回复 regeneration on a full-HP member all bank into barriers — and every enemy hit against a barriered member detonates (1000+10·L) true damage around them.
notes: 2026-10-06 (user): the bond no longer funds its own layers from healing. The old `layer_heal_step` accumulator (1 layer per 200 HP a member landed, `layer_battle_cap` 40) stacked up to +40 a round on a medic-heavy board, on top of the operators' own layer 特质 — which read as 「异常叠层」 and was removed. Both bb keys are gone from the record.

2026-10-05 redesign (user): the 3-tier boost moved from healing DEALT to healing RECEIVED (治疗和生命回复), the overflow barrier moved from tier 3 to tier 6 and now sits on the member, the detonation retimed from on-break arts (300+15·L, 1 s) to on-chip true damage (1000+10·L, 1 s per member), and the once-per-battle shield save was removed.

Medics keep the engine's "injured ally first" target rule (no global full-HP fallback — user decision 2026-10-05). The only full-HP heal vector is Mon3tr the 链愈师 (chain jumps to a random full-HP ally when nobody in range is injured, the official 链愈师 rule), plus 生命回复 regeneration and heals that overflow past a member's missing HP. 禁疗 / 孤立 / devices stay excluded.
assumed: overheal is measured per heal instance (engine `opts.overheal`), never banked between instances beyond the shield cap
the barrier behaves like 砾's 屏障 (absorbs damage before HP, capped) but does not decay: no duration, no per-second rescale (user decision)
a barrier chip is detected via the `hit`/`damaged` hook pair (shield snapshot before absorb vs live value after); the damage must be enemy-sourced (因敌人攻击)
HP-regen (生命回复) rides the same heal pipeline, so the received boost covers it and a full-HP member's regen overflows into the barrier too
